displayPattern: 7-segment display on a single-stage *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 furnace (IOG-2037B): EE5
diySteps: Technician: locate and correct the short in low voltage wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: a fuse that blows again means a wiring short that must be found. This page is the single-stage IOG-2037B chart (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide). A two-stage *CVC96 or *MVC96 uses IOG-2015L instead.
